design_gotchas.title: DBV Thermal Resistance (231.1 C/W JEDEC) vs Page-1 Headline 60.3 C/W (DYD Exposed-Pad Only)
design_gotchas.detail: The Page 1 feature bullet advertises '60.3 °C/W RθJA in SOT-23-5', but Table 5.4 proves that metric applies ONLY to the exposed-pad DYD package on TI's LP087A EVM. The standard DBV OPN (TLV75533PDBVR, no thermal pad) has RθJA = 231.1 °C/W on a JEDEC 2s2p board (100.8 °C/W on EVM). Never budget 500 mA at 5 V->3.3 V (0.85 W) in DBV without thermal derating or switching to DYD.

design_gotchas.title: Tight 5.5 V Max Operating / 6.0 V Abs Max Input Voltage Margin on 5 V Rails
design_gotchas.detail: TLV75533PDBVR has a 5.5 V recommended max and 6.0 V absolute maximum VIN rating (lower than AP2112K and TPS7A02 at 6.0 V/6.5 V). USB 5 V hot-plug inductive overshoot or poorly regulated 5 V wall adapters can easily breach 6.0 V without TVS or bulk input clamping.

design_gotchas.title: No Internal Reverse-Current Protection — Body Diode Conducts When VOUT > VIN + 0.3 V
design_gotchas.detail: Section 7.1.4 explicitly warns that excessive reverse current through the PMOS body diode can cause electromigration, overheating, or latch-up when VOUT exceeds VIN + 0.3 V (e.g., large COUT during VIN collapse or externally back-driven rail). Add an external Schottky diode from OUT to IN if reverse bias is possible.

design_gotchas.title: DC-Bias Derating Must Keep Effective COUT >= 0.47 uF (and <= 200 uF)
design_gotchas.detail: TI specifies a nominal 1 uF X5R/X7R ceramic capacitor assuming 50% derating, requiring at least 0.47 uF actual effective capacitance at 3.3 V DC bias (avoid tiny 0201/0402 6.3 V parts that lose >60% capacitance at 3.3 V).

typical_use_cases: High-efficiency 3.6 V–4.2 V Li-Ion to 3.3 V rails up to 500 mA with ultra-low 150 mV typical dropout
Compact SOT-23-5 microcontroller and camera-sensor rails needing ±1% accuracy (-40..+85°C) and 25 uA IQ
Sequenced digital rails utilizing built-in monotonic soft-start (550 us) and 120 Ohm active output discharge
Direct low-Iq, low-dropout upgrade candidate for AP2112K-3.3TRG1 footprints when VIN stays <= 5.5 V
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV75533PDBVR is a 500 mA fixed 3.3 V (±1% from -40°C to +85°C) low-dropout CMOS regulator in a standard 5-pin DBV SOT-23-5 package (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN active high, 4=NC, 5=OUT) with 120 Ohm active output discharge and built-in soft-start. Operating from 1.45 V to 5.5 V (6.0 V abs max), it achieves 150 mV typical dropout at 500 mA, 25 uA quiescent current, 0.1 uA shutdown current, 52 dB PSRR at 1 kHz, 71.5 uVRMS noise, and 1 uF ceramic cap stability. Engineers must note its 231.1 °C/W JEDEC RθJA in DBV (not the DYD exposed-pad 60.3 °C/W metric), tight 6.0 V abs max rating, and lack of internal reverse-current protection.
